↕ / 🔎 / 🪝In 🧠 Think: predict the arrows, then hunt the stem clue or recall the mnemonic (tap to reveal). Chips filter clues, ⚠️ traps, 🇬🇧 US-vs-UK and 🪝 hooks; HY = High-Yield, FA = Core Foundations. Full sets live in the Frameworks library tabs.
🔑Clinchers: under every condition title, the finding or lab combination that settles it (✅) or rules it out (❌), plus key 🧪 patterns. Open it once and it stays open.
🩺 / 🧬In 🧠 Think: an Clinical case (open one step at a time, then one SBA) and a short Pathophysiology "why it happens" card. Every case sits under its ILO; all 29 complaints are in the 🩺 Cases library tab.
